title: TabQueryBench: A Query-Centric Benchmark for Synthetic Tabular Data
abstract: arXiv:2607.03926v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Synthetic tabular data support use cases like data sharing, model development under access restrictions, and rapid prototyping of analytical workflows. Modern generative models are evaluated by their statistical similarity, correlation structure, privacy, and downstream machine-learning utility. However, such evaluations leave a gap: they rarely test the structure that matters for analytical queries. We present TabQueryBench, a query-centric benchmark for evaluating synthetic tabular data with SQL-shaped analytical queries. TabQueryBench distills 12 public query sources into 44 reusable query templates and grounds them to each dataset through a policy-guided template-to-SQL pipeline. Across 49 datasets and 11 generative models, it produces more than 100 executable queries per dataset while preserving cross-model comparability. translated_title: TabQueryBench：一个面向查询的合成表格数据基准
translated_abstract: 合成表格数据支持数据共享、访问受限条件下的模型开发以及分析工作流的快速原型设计等应用场景。现代生成模型通常通过统计相似性、相关结构、隐私性和下游机器学习效用来评估。然而，这类评估存在一个空白：它们很少测试对分析查询至关重要的结构。我们提出了TabQueryBench，一个以查询为中心的基准，用于通过SQL形式的分析查询评估合成表格数据。TabQueryBench将12个公开查询来源提炼为44个可复用的查询模板，并通过策略引导的模板到SQL管道将其与每个数据集关联。在49个数据集和11个生成模型上，该基准为每个数据集生成超过100个可执行查询，同时保持跨模型的可比性。我们的评估揭示了传统保真度与以查询为中心的保真度之间的显著差距。
tldr: 本文提出TabQueryBench，一个以查询为中心的合成表格数据评估基准，通过将12个查询来源提炼为44个可复用模板，在49个数据集上生成SQL可执行查询，揭示了传统统计保真度评估与查询中心保真度之间的显著差距。
en_tdlr: TabQueryBench is a query-centric benchmark that evaluates synthetic tabular data using SQL-shaped analytical queries, distilling 12 public query sources into 44 reusable templates and revealing a substantial gap between conventional statistical fidelity and query-centric fidelity.
